discovery.summary: The source is an SRS for “Project Aegis”, a web-based credit card management system consisting of a browser portal (React SPA) and a REST API (v2). It defines end-to-end workflows for user authentication, a 3-step credit application process, transaction initiation and listing (including foreign fee logic), account dashboard and card controls (freeze/unfreeze, lost/stolen, PIN), billing statement retrieval and payment submission, plus security/compliance and non-functional requirements including PCI, CSRF, session timeout, masking, latency, scalability, and audit trail expectations.
discovery.domain: BFSI / fintech (credit card management: portal + REST API)

workflows.name: System entry points & base URLs (API + Portal + WebSocket)
workflows.description: Validate the documented base API URL, portal URL, API versioning, TLS minimum, and presence of the WebSocket live transaction feed endpoint.
workflows.rationale: Multiple entry points are explicitly listed (API base URL, portal, version v2, TLS 1.3 minimum, and WebSocket endpoint). Coverage includes correct routing and protocol constraints.

workflows.name: OAuth 2.0 session model & token storage constraints
workflows.description: Verify OAuth 2.0 Authorization Code Flow with PKCE is used for portal sessions and tokens are stored only in HttpOnly, Secure cookies (never in localStorage).
workflows.rationale: Explicit security/session storage requirements require dedicated verification (PKCE flow usage + cookie storage + prohibition of localStorage).

workflows.name: User Registration (POST /v2/auth/register)
workflows.description: Create new portal user accounts with full field validation, uniqueness, and correct HTTP/error handling including verification email trigger.
workflows.rationale: Registration has 9 required fields with multiple validation rules (length, formats, age >=18, complexity, uniqueness, agree_terms) plus 4 documented response outcomes (201/400/409/422). BVA needed for name lengths and password min 12.

workflows.name: Login & Token Issuance (POST /v2/auth/login)
workflows.description: Authenticate users and issue JWT access/refresh tokens with support for optional MFA fields, remember_me behavior, lockouts, and rate limiting.
workflows.rationale: Login includes required credentials plus optional fields (mfa_code/device_id/remember_me) and has multiple outcome branches (200/401/403 lock after 5 failed/429 rate limit 10 req/min per IP).

workflows.name: Token Refresh (POST /v2/auth/token/refresh) with rotation
workflows.description: Issue new access tokens via refresh token with enforced single-use rotation and invalid/expired token handling.
workflows.rationale: Refresh token rotation is explicitly enforced (single-use); requires replay-protection checks plus success and TOKEN_INVALID handling (200/401).

workflows.name: Credit Application Flow sequencing & draft auto-save
workflows.description: Validate 3-step sequential application ordering, session_token issuance/usage across steps, and auto-save draft behavior to localStorage every 60 seconds.
workflows.rationale: Multi-step dependency plus explicit timing/storage behavior (auto-save every 60 seconds to localStorage) creates state/sequence and security-adjacent coverage needs.

workflows.name: Application Step 1 — Personal Information (POST /v2/applications/start)
workflows.description: Start a new credit application with personal/address/ID validation and enforce duplicate in-progress behavior.
workflows.rationale: Multiple required fields and schema validations (address, province code, postal format, enums, max lengths) plus outcomes 201/400/409 (DUPLICATE_APPLICATION).

workflows.name: Application Step 2 — Financial Information (POST /v2/applications/{application_id}/financials)
workflows.description: Submit financials with X-App-Session session_token, enforce required/conditional fields, and handle session expiry while triggering soft credit pull queued status.
workflows.rationale: Many rules: header token expires 30 min, employment_status enum, employer_name required conditionally, income bounds (max 9,999,999.99), defaults (other_income), numeric constraints, and sin_consent must be true; outcomes 200/400/401 SESSION_EXPIRED.

workflows.name: Application Step 3 — Decision & Card Selection (POST /v2/applications/{application_id}/submit)
workflows.description: Finalize application with card_product_id and e_signature, apply FICO-based decision outcomes, and validate signature requirement and marketing_opt_in default.
workflows.rationale: Decision table has 3 FICO branches with distinct response keys plus error branch for missing/malformed e_signature; also validates required card_product_id and default marketing_opt_in false.

workflows.name: Initiate a Web Transaction (POST /v2/accounts/{account_id}/transactions)
workflows.description: Authorize and post a web-initiated transaction with field validations, ownership checks, over-limit buffer behavior, and documented declines/errors including frequency cap.
workflows.rationale: High-impact money movement workflow with many validation rules (amount >0, MCC format, exchange_rate conditional, enums) plus multiple outcomes (200 approved, 200 over_limit_flag, 402/403/422/429 with mfa_required). Includes ownership constraint in path param.

workflows.name: List Transactions (GET /v2/accounts/{account_id}/transactions)
workflows.description: Retrieve paginated transaction history with date range validation, pagination bounds, optional category filtering, and owner-only access enforcement.
workflows.rationale: Covers pagination defaults and bounds (page min 1, per_page max 100), date validation (to_date >= from_date), category enum filter, and forbidden access.

workflows.name: Foreign Transaction Fee Calculation (REQ-006)
workflows.description: Validate foreign transaction total and itemized fee calculation when currency_code is not CAD, including dependency on exchange_rate.
workflows.rationale: Explicit formula and itemization requirement require golden-value and boundary/precision coverage; also ties to exchange_rate conditionality from transaction initiation.

workflows.name: Get Account Summary (GET /v2/accounts/{account_id}/summary)
workflows.description: Retrieve balances, credit and billing cycle information with include_rewards default behavior and owner-only access control.
workflows.rationale: Validates response keys + include_rewards default false and forbidden access when token doesn’t own account (200/403).

workflows.name: Update Card Status Freeze/Unfreeze (PATCH /v2/cards/{card_id}/status)
workflows.description: Allow users to change card status only between Active and Frozen with OTP confirmation and audit logging of reason; enforce invalid transition and OTP failure handling.
workflows.rationale: State transition constraints (only {Active,Frozen}) + OTP requirement + audit trail logging of reason, with explicit errors (INVALID_TRANSITION, OTP_FAILED) and success response keys.

workflows.name: Report Card Lost or Stolen (POST /v2/cards/{card_id}/report-lost)
workflows.description: Block card and trigger re-issue workflow with irreversible operation and duplicate blocked handling.
workflows.rationale: Irreversible state change with enum validation (LOST/STOLEN) and optional fields; includes 200 success and 409 ALREADY_BLOCKED branch.

workflows.name: Set Web-Based PIN (PUT /v2/cards/{card_id}/pin)
workflows.description: Set/reset a virtual PIN with format/confirmation validation, required OTP, encrypted transmission requirement, and blocked-card restriction.
workflows.rationale: Multiple constraints: exactly 4 digits, confirm match, session_otp required, transmitted encrypted (RSA-OAEP), and 400/403 error branches plus 200 success.

workflows.name: Retrieve Statement (GET /v2/accounts/{account_id}/statements/{statement_id})
workflows.description: Return billing statements in JSON/PDF formats with correct response fields and 404 NOT_FOUND behavior.
workflows.rationale: Endpoint has format enum default JSON, required path params, defined response keys, and explicit 404 behavior; requires both format paths and error handling.

workflows.name: Billing calculations: Interest (REQ-009 ADB method)
workflows.description: Validate interest computed using ADB, APR, day-count, and days-in-cycle per the defined formula.
workflows.rationale: Explicit numeric formula requires golden-value, boundary/precision and day-count variation coverage.

workflows.name: Billing calculations: Grace period eligibility (REQ-010)
workflows.description: Validate grace period (21 days) is applied only when prior statement balance is paid in full.
workflows.rationale: Binary decision rule based on prev_statement_balance_paid_in_full; requires both branches and a control/consistency check.

workflows.name: Billing calculations: Late fee trigger (REQ-011)
workflows.description: Validate late fee of $35.00 is charged only when payment_received_date exceeds due_date by more than 2 days.
workflows.rationale: Date-threshold rule needs boundary cases around due_date + 2 days (before, exactly, after) and correct fee application.

workflows.name: Billing calculations: Rewards accrual (REQ-012) and rounding (REQ-013)
workflows.description: Validate rewards multipliers for Travel MCC vs other and enforce floor() rounding only (never round/ceil).
workflows.rationale: Two coupled numeric rules: multiplier by category plus rounding constraint; requires cross-checking fractional amounts and ensuring floor applied.

workflows.name: Statement accuracy tolerance (REQ-015)
workflows.description: Validate statement total_spend matches sum(transaction_amount[]) within ±$0.01 tolerance.
workflows.rationale: Explicit tolerance rule requires cases within tolerance and just outside tolerance; high risk for reconciliation correctness.

workflows.name: Make a Payment (POST /v2/accounts/{account_id}/payments)
workflows.description: Submit payments from linked bank accounts with amount rules, scheduling rules, payment_type enum, and error handling for below-minimum and invalid bank account.
workflows.rationale: Payment workflow has key validations (min $1.00, max=total_balance, payment_amount vs minimum_payment_due), scheduling date rule (future or omitted), required bank_account_id pre-linked, and documented 200/400/422 outcomes.

workflows.name: PAN masking & non-exposure (REQ-014)
workflows.description: Ensure PAN is displayed masked in the browser and full PAN is never transmitted to the frontend.
workflows.rationale: Explicit masking and data exposure constraints; requires UI/API payload inspection coverage.

workflows.name: Right to Rescind / Account deletion window (REQ-016)
workflows.description: Validate DELETE /v2/accounts/{{id}} is allowed only within 14 days post-issuance with no membership fee, and rejected after Day 14.
workflows.rationale: Time-window and fee constraint are explicitly stated; requires within-window success and post-window rejection behavior verification.

workflows.name: PCI-DSS web controls: TLS 1.3 + iframe tokenisation + no PAN in DOM (NFR-01)
workflows.description: Verify all web forms use TLS 1.3 and card entry uses iframe tokenisation with no raw PAN in the DOM.
workflows.rationale: Security compliance controls require explicit verification across transport and frontend rendering constraints.

workflows.name: CSRF protection & SameSite cookies (NFR-05)
workflows.description: Validate state-changing endpoints require X-CSRF-Token and SameSite=Strict cookie policy is enforced.
workflows.rationale: Applies to all state-changing endpoints; needs at least token present vs missing/invalid and cookie attribute enforcement checks.

workflows.name: Session timeout and warning modal (NFR-06)
workflows.description: Verify portal sessions expire after 15 minutes inactivity and a 2-minute warning modal appears before auto-logout.
workflows.rationale: Explicit UX/security timeout behavior includes two timing thresholds (15 min expiry, 2-minute warning) requiring dedicated verification.

workflows.name: Audit trail for credit_limit changes (NFR-04)
workflows.description: Validate that any credit_limit change results in an immutable audit log record with required fields.
workflows.rationale: Audit requirement is explicit about fields (user_id, session_id, ip_address, timestamp_utc) and immutability, requiring creation and integrity checks.

workflows.name: API latency & portal TTI budgets (NFR-02)
workflows.description: Validate non-functional performance targets for API p95 latency and portal Time-to-Interactive on 4G.
workflows.rationale: Two explicit measurable targets (API p95 ≤ 1,500 ms; portal TTI ≤ 3s on 4G) each needs at least one verification point.

workflows.name: Scalability & autoscaling trigger (NFR-03)
workflows.description: Validate gateway concurrency requirement and autoscaling trigger condition when CPU utilization reaches 70%.
workflows.rationale: Two explicit scalability requirements (5,000 concurrent req/sec and autoscaling at 70% CPU) warrant dedicated load/trigger validation.

workflows.name: Notification & Alert Webhooks (POST /v2/notifications/webhook)
workflows.description: Send alerts with enum validations, idempotency de-duplication, and correct delivered/queued responses and error handling.
workflows.rationale: Webhook payload has multiple required fields and enums (alert_type/channel/severity), message max length, idempotency_key UUID v4 with duplicate suppression, and 200/400/409 outcomes.
